evidence.statement: The 35 frozen mitochondrial MOP occurrences decompose internally into {'intergenic': 26, 'rRNA': 2, 'protein_coding_CDS': 6, 'unresolved': 1} under the predeclared non-organellar mitochondrial classifier.
LC-PRED-0016 mitochondrial-intergenic ratio is 1.2196 with exact upper-tail 0.0710882; outcome MIXED_WEAKENED.
The global organellar enrichment must be decomposed internally; mitochondria cannot be treated as one semantic class merely because the whole replicon was enriched.
